A moment of gratitude, every few days.

Appreciation Cards turn up in your Q&A list on their own.
Five kinds: gratitude, compliment, affirmation, cheer, and promise.
Sent exactly as you wrote it — Dear doesn't tidy it up.
They answer with a heart, and a line if they feel like it.
